items.why: Already present: the Paper lantern kind carries the alias 'chōchin' and the archetypes Gifu chōchin, Odawara chōchin and Suifu (Mito) chōchin in rebuild/out/B3.json.

record.d: Hanging or wall lantern of hammered brass sheet pierced with geometric and floral designs, often with coloured glass panels, made in Morocco (e.g. Fez) from the 19th century on.
record.dt: clear, frosted or coloured glass · hanging or wall · electrified

items.why: Origin version of Decorative lantern; the piercing technique stays in VE. 1stDibs lists 'Berber Tribes of Morocco' only as a bare tradition label, which is not a brand under the owner's rule, so no maker recorded.
